classification.rationale: Apex trigger/service change to PO receiving path (LandedCostAllocator, ICHCostCalculationService, ItemCostHistoryService, PurchaseOrderTriggerHandler) + 3 new Item_Cost_History__c currency fields. Effect observable in Lightning (ICH landed-cost breakdown, Current_Item_Cost__c). Validated primarily via Apex test classes (org-run), not CSV data loads.

data.solutionSummary: Shop 1.0 excluded PO expenses (freight/tax/handling/etc.) from the moving weighted average cost, understating Current_Item_Cost__c/COGS/margin. The fix adds LandedCostAllocator (prorates a PO's Total_Expenses__c by value across received lines, fallback by qty when total value=0, exact reconciliation with remainder to largest line, 6-decimal internal precision), a new 3-arg overload of ICHCostCalculationService.calculateWeightedAverageCost that accepts an effective-cost override (2-arg delegates with null = fully backward compatible raw-cost path), and wires it into ItemCostHistoryService's create (buildICHs) and recalc (recalculateICHsFromOrders) paths. PurchaseOrderTriggerHandler now also re-prorates already-received lines when a PO's expenses change AFTER receipt (edit/add expense post-receipt), clearing the allocator's transaction-scoped cache first. 3 new ICH fields (Unit_Cost__c, Allocated_Expense__c, Effective_Cost__c) persist the landed-cost breakdown per receipt.

ac-4 (ICH breakdown, linked to order): twoLineReceiptProratesExpenseByValue (values only, no explicit order-link assertion)
ac-6 (every expense type folds in, no ex: architecturally satisfied (generic Purchase_Order_Expense__c sum, no type filtering) but no test combines 3+ concurrent expense line types
